top_choice_rationale: P001 credits the physiology of GLP-1 and its active forms to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov. The chain from incretin physiology and proglucagon processing, through the active truncated peptide and its receptor, to therapies validated in large randomized outcome trials in diabetes and obesity, is original, mature and independently confirmed. The three-name allocation and citation scope reward the physiology rather than specific drug molecules. Residual priority questions around Mojsov are real but do not outweigh the achievement, so an award is preferred to no award.
